key: CUEBALL: What do you think you're doing up here?
en: CUEBALL: What do you think you're doing up here?
ja: ツッパリ：お前、ここで何してるつもりだ?

key: ROUGHNECK: How'd you find out we were here? Did someone squeal?!
en: ROUGHNECK: How'd you find out we were here? Did someone squeal?!
ja: チンピラ：どうやってここにいるのがバレたんだ? 誰かがチクったのか!?

key: I don't think this was in the plan.
en: I don't think this was in the plan.
ja: これ、計画にはなかったと思うんですけど。

key: Uhh... Boss?
en: Uhh... Boss?
ja: あの……ボス?

key: CUEBALL: Tch, even two on one...
en: CUEBALL: Tch, even two on one...
ja: ツッパリ：チッ、二対一だってのに……

key: ROUGHNECK: No way...
en: ROUGHNECK: No way...
ja: チンピラ：うそだろ……

key: ???: Fufufufu...
en: ???: Fufufufu...
ja: ???：ふふふふ……

key: I suppose it can't be helped.
en: I suppose it can't be helped.
ja: しょうがないな。

key: I'll deal with this myself.
en: I'll deal with this myself.
ja: オレが自分で片づけてやるよ。

key: ???: Up here, peabrain.
en: ???: Up here, peabrain.
ja: ???：上だよ、おバカさん。

key: ???: You figure it out yet?
en: ???: You figure it out yet?
ja: ???：もうわかったか?

key: Of course not.
en: Of course not.
ja: わかるわけないか。

key: You're probably just some dumb searchman sent by my mother or the police to save me, right?
en: You're probably just some dumb searchman sent by my mother or the police to save me, right?
ja: どうせお前、オレのおふくろか警察に送り込まれた、間抜けな捜索屋か何かだろ?

key: Still, congrats on making it through these muscle-headed meatbags.
en: Still, congrats on making it through these muscle-headed meatbags.
ja: それでも、この筋肉バカどもを突破してきたのは褒めてやるよ。

key: That means you're at least one evolutionary step above these Primeapes.
en: That means you're at least one evolutionary step above these Primeapes.
ja: つまりお前は、少なくともこのオコリザルどもより一段階は進化してるってわけだ。

key: But let me introduce myself.
en: But let me introduce myself.
ja: とりあえず、自己紹介させてもらうか。

key: My name's Eustace.
en: My name's Eustace.
ja: 名前はユースタス。

key: I'm the victim of this here operation,
en: I'm the victim of this here operation,
ja: このオペレーションの被害者であり、

key: And I'm also the brains behind it.
en: And I'm also the brains behind it.
ja: 同時に、その頭脳でもある。

key: I may be young, but I've lost enough to know how the world works.
en: I may be young, but I've lost enough to know how the world works.
ja: 若いかもしれないが、世の中の仕組みを知るには十分なものを失ってきたんだ。

key: People just take whatever they want, right?
en: People just take whatever they want, right?
ja: 人は結局、欲しいものを勝手に奪っていくだけだろ?

key: Well, there's an easy solution to that:
en: Well, there's an easy solution to that:
ja: だったら、答えは簡単だ。

key: Take what you want first.
en: Take what you want first.
ja: 先に、自分の欲しいものを奪えばいい。

key: Do you understand? Probably not.
en: Do you understand? Probably not.
ja: わかるか? まあ、無理だろうな。

key: See, my uncle's a famous musician. Real popular in Kalos and Unova.
en: See, my uncle's a famous musician. Real popular in Kalos and Unova.
ja: いいか、オレのおじさんは有名なミュージシャンでね。カロスとイッシュじゃかなりの人気なんだ。

key: Naturally, he's loaded.
en: Naturally, he's loaded.
ja: 当然、金はうなるほど持ってる。

key: But he doesn't do anything with his money, so I thought, why don't I?
en: But he doesn't do anything with his money, so I thought, why don't I?
ja: でも、その金で何もしてないんだから、だったらオレがもらってやろうと思ってさ。

key: I got in touch with these Pignite-looking goons and had them pretend to kidnap me.
en: I got in touch with these Pignite-looking goons and had them pretend to kidnap me.
ja: このチャオブーみたいなゴロツキどもに連絡を取って、オレを誘拐したふりをさせたんだ。

key: Then, as soon as we get the ransom payment from my uncle, I can give them their cut and take the rest for myself.
en: Then, as soon as we get the ransom payment from my uncle, I can give them their cut and take the rest for myself.
ja: おじさんから身代金を受け取ったら、こいつらに取り分をやって、残りは全部オレのものにする。

key: Not bad, right?
en: Not bad, right?
ja: 悪くないだろ?

key: But here's the thing.
en: But here's the thing.
ja: でも、ここからが問題でな。

key: I can't get rescued before then.
en: I can't get rescued before then.
ja: それまでは助け出されるわけにはいかないんだ。

key: And here you are tryin' to rescue me. What gives?
en: And here you are tryin' to rescue me. What gives?
ja: なのに、君は僕を助けようとしてる。一体どういうつもりだい?

key: Well, you know why I'm telling you all this, right?
en: Well, you know why I'm telling you all this, right?
ja: まあ、なんでこんな話をしてるかわかるよね?

key: Obviously, I can't let you leave now.
en: Obviously, I can't let you leave now.
ja: 当然、もう君をここから帰すわけにはいかない。

key: Wha-- Adults ruin everything!
en: Wha-- Adults ruin everything!
ja: な――大人はいつだって全部台無しにするんだ!

key: EUSTACE: Uggh!
en: EUSTACE: Uggh!
ja: ユースタス: うぐっ!

key: Stupid adults, always trying to get in the way!
en: Stupid adults, always trying to get in the way!
ja: バカな大人どもが、いつも邪魔ばかりしやがって!

key: But you never do anything to actually help!
en: But you never do anything to actually help!
ja: なのに、実際には何にも手伝いやしない!

key: I quit!
en: I quit!
ja: もうやめだ!

key: The operation's blown anyway.
en: The operation's blown anyway.
ja: どうせ作戦はもうバレてる。

key: EUSTACE: You're fired.
en: EUSTACE: You're fired.
ja: ユースタス: お前はクビだ。

key: EUSTACE: You're fired too.
en: EUSTACE: You're fired too.
ja: ユースタス: お前もクビだ。

key: EUSTACE: I can't fire you, but if I could, you better believe you'd be fired.
en: EUSTACE: I can't fire you, but if I could, you better believe you'd be fired.
ja: ユースタス: 君のことはクビにできないけど、できるならとっくにクビにしてるところだよ。

key: Anyway, I'm going home.
en: Anyway, I'm going home.
ja: とにかく、僕は家に帰る。
